app.name: CoupleLink

app.previewOnly: Preview only. No real messages or device feedback.
app.persistError: Could not save preferences. Changes may be lost after restart.
home.subtitle: Little moments. Our favorite story.
home.interactionSubtitle: Let them know they are on your mind
home.distanceNote: A little distance, a lot of love
home.petMood: Waiting for you both to come home
home.emptyHint: Use Edit home to bring back your cards
home.layoutHint: Hold a card to edit. Hiding cards does not revoke sharing.
home.layoutSubtitle: Drag to reorder, or hide a card with its switch.
interaction.ringHint: Real ringing will honor the recipient's consent, quiet hours and cooldown. No sound plays in this preview.
interaction.editorHint: Changes only the local label, not the gesture. Leave empty to reset.
map.title: A little closer
map.subtitle: Always a way back to you
map.stateHint: Preview different states. No system permissions are requested.
map.recordHint: Recording is separate from sharing. Preview only.
map.privacyHint: Pause any time. Real location is not yet connected. No data is collected or uploaded.

chat.subtitle: Some words are only ours

chat.sample3: Yes! Already looking forward to it ♡
chat.attachment: Image and voice sending will arrive with the messaging service
chat.noPermission: No microphone or photo permissions requested

time.albumHint: A home for every little memory
time.timelineHint: Even the little things belong here
time.memory2: A letter full of little thoughts
time.albumPreviewHint: Built-in color illustrations. No real photos are accessed.
time.anniversaryHint: Dates are fixed in the preview. The real version will use your shared time zone and start date.
me.title: My little world
me.subtitle: Closer, in your own way
me.profile: A private space for you and Lin

me.about: Keep a little love within reach

pet.title: Marshmallow's home
pet.subtitle: A little happiness, growing with both of you
pet.preview: Pet preview. Progress is not synced or saved.
pet.fed: Marshmallow is full and nuzzles your hand
feedback.suppressed: Blocked by quiet mode or system feedback settings
feedback.unsupported: This device or browser does not support this preview
feedback.failed: Could not run local feedback. Please try again.
feedback.soundHint: Plays only here and honors silent and quiet modes. Closing stops sound.
feedback.vibrationHint: Tests only this phone. Availability depends on its haptic settings.
account.title: Account & pairing
account.connectHint: Connect to your CoupleLink server. Register with a username, display name and password.
account.usernameHint: Use 3–32 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens
account.vaultHint: Android sessions use secure storage. Browser preview sessions stay in memory.
account.bindHint: One person creates an invite. The other enters it and sets your start date and time zone.
account.inviteExpiry: Valid for 15 minutes. A new invite revokes older ones.
account.unbindHint: Ends this pairing, invalidates old invites and clears its local chat cache, draft and unsent messages. Pairing again requires a new invite.
account.revokeHint: This device will need to sign in again. Revoking this device signs you out.
account.connected: Connected. Profile data comes from your account.
account.cached: Sync failed. Showing the last profile snapshot.
account.scopeHint: Text chat and foreground interactions are live. Location, media, background push and band sync are not connected yet.
account.error.https_required: HTTP is not enabled for this address. Enabled addresses: {hosts}.
account.error.invalid_input: Check the username, date, time zone and other fields.
account.error.conflict: Account or device already exists. Try another name or sign in.
account.error.invalid_invitation: Invite is invalid, expired or already used
account.error.self_invitation: You cannot use your own invitation
account.error.already_bound: One person is already paired. Refresh the profile.
account.error.version_conflict: Pairing changed on another device. Refresh and try again.
account.error.unauthorized: Session expired or was revoked. Sign in again.
account.error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
account.error.network_timeout: Connection timed out. Check your server and network.
account.error.network_failed: Cannot connect. Check the server address, port and network.
account.error.invalid_response: Server response does not match the current protocol
account.error.server_error: Server could not complete the request
account.error.session_restore_failed: Could not restore the secure session. Sign in again.
account.error.device_in_use: This device identifier belongs to another account
account.error.device_not_found: Device does not belong to this account
account.error.invalid_cursor: Sync cursor is invalid. Sign out and back in.
account.error.origin_not_allowed: Server does not allow this browser preview origin
account.error.secure_storage_failed: System secure storage is unavailable. This session has stopped; check your device and sign in again.
account.serverHint: LAN HTTP addresses enabled in this build: {hosts}. HTTP transmits data without encryption.
chat.live.bindHint: Pair with your partner to start a real conversation.
chat.live.subtitle: Make room for every little hello.
chat.live.offline: Offline · Messages will retry when connected
chat.live.notice: Text is stored on your server. Delivered means saved by the other client, not read. Media and background push are not connected yet.
chat.live.queued: {count} messages waiting, saved on this device
chat.error.invalid_message: Enter a message of up to 4000 characters.
chat.error.message_id_conflict: This message ID belongs to different content. Cancel it and compose a new message.
chat.error.queue_full: The local send queue is full. Connect or review pending messages before retrying.
chat.error.chat_storage_failed: Chat storage is unavailable. Check free device space and retry.
chat.error.relationship_changed: Your relationship changed. Pending messages for the old relationship have stopped.
account.error.logout_remote_failed: Signed out locally. The server could not confirm logout; revoke this device from another signed-in device.
interaction.receivedHint: Your partner sent this interaction. Feedback follows your settings.
interaction.sent: Interaction sent; waiting for your partner.
interaction.allowVibrationHint: Request system haptic feedback for interactions received in the foreground.
interaction.allowSoundHint: Off by default. Sound still follows silent mode, Do Not Disturb and volume.
interaction.error.network_failed: Send result is unknown. Check your connection and server.
interaction.error.relationship_changed: The pairing changed. Refresh your account.
interaction.result.suppressed: Recipient or system settings blocked sound or vibration
account.error.invalid_server_address: Enter a complete HTTP or HTTPS server address.
account.probe.invalid_server_address: Invalid address. Enter a complete HTTP or HTTPS URL.
account.probe.server_unreachable: The server returned an error. Check its address and status.
account.probe.incompatible_server: Connected, but this is not a compatible CoupleLink server.
account.probe.timeout: Connection timed out. Check the phone network, hotspot and firewall.
account.probe.unreachable: Connection failed. Check the address, network and server.
account.probe.https_required: HTTP is not enabled for this address. Enabled addresses: {hosts}.
notification.title: System notifications
notification.hint: Allow notifications for message alerts and banners. Background connection shows a persistent status notification.
notification.permissionDenied: Notifications are disabled. Allow them in system settings.
notification.testSent: Test notification requested. Check your notification shade.
notification.messageBody: Your partner sent you a message.
notification.pairFirst: Sign in and pair, then wait for message synchronization.
notification.backgroundStarted: Background reception started; system restrictions may interrupt it.
notification.backgroundFailed: Could not start or stop background reception. Check permissions and system settings.
address.title: Server addresses
address.hint: Save multiple addresses, test them, and switch manually. Switching requires signing in again; the old token is never sent to the new address.
address.invalid: Enter a complete HTTP or HTTPS address.
